description:
Configure a new product attribute in Drupal Commerce to allow products to have color variations.

1. Create a new Product Attribute with the label 'Color'.
2. Add exactly these five values to the Color attribute (in any order):
   - Midnight Black
   - Arctic White
   - Ocean Blue
   - Forest Green
   - Sunset Red
3. Enable this attribute on the 'Default' product variation type so it can be used for products.

The Drupal admin credentials are admin / Admin1234! and the site is at http://localhost.
